en: Revelation 1

p.src: 1  This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

ja: これはイエス・キリストの啓
こるべきことをご自分の僕たちに
すため、この啓示をキリストに
わして、ご自分の僕ヨハネに
en: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,
u.src: 1  This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

ja:
1:1 「キリスト」は「油を注がれた者」という意味である。
1:1 または「使者」（ここ、および御使いが言及されるすべての箇所）
en:
1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.
1:1 or, messenger (here and wherever angel is mentioned)

p.src: 2  who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

ja: ヨハネは、自分が見たすべてのことを、
とイエス・キリストのあかしとして
en: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.
u.src: 2  who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

p.src: 3  Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

en: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.
u.src: 3  Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

p.src: 4  John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

ja: ヨハネから、アジアにある
おられ、かつておられ、やがて
en: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;
u.src: 4  John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

p.src: 5  and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

ja: であるイエス・キリストから、
en: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—
u.src: 5  and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

p.src: 6  and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

ja: が永遠にあるように。アーメン。
en: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
u.src: 6  and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

ja: 1:6 出エジプト記19:6、イザヤ書61:6
en: 1:6 Exodus 19:6; Isaiah 61:6

p.src: 7  Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

ja: く。そのとおりである。アーメン。
en: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.
u.src: 7  Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

ja: 1:7 「見よ」はギリシャ語の「ἰδοὺ」に由来し、目を向ける、注意する、観察する、見る、またはじっと見るという意味である。しばしば間投詞として用いられる。
en: 1:7 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 8  “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

ja: 「わたしはアルファであり、オメガである。」と主なる神は言われる。「
おられ、かつておられ、やがて
en: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
u.src: 8  “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

ja:
1:8 TRは「初めであり、終わりである」を加えている。
1:8 TRは「神」を省いている。
zh: 1:8 阿拉法，俄梅戛：是希臘字母首末二字
en:
1:8 TR adds “the Beginning and the End”
1:8 TR omits “God”

p.src: 9  I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

ja: であり、キリスト・イエスにある苦
にともにあずかる者である
とイエス・キリストのあかしのために、パトモスと
en: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
u.src: 9  I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

p.src: 10  I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet
u.src: 10  I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

p.src: 11  saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

ja: 、すなわちエフェソ、スミルナ、ペルガモン、テアティラ、サルディス、フィラデルフィア、ラオディキアに
en: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

1:11 TRは「アジアにある」を加えている。
en:
1:11 TR adds “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last.”
1:11 TR adds “which are in Asia”

p.src: 12  I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

ja: 私は、私に語りかけた声を見ようと振り向いた。振り向くと、七つの金の燭台が見えた。
zh: 我轉過身來，要看是誰發聲與我說話；既轉過來，就看見七個金燈臺。
en: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.
u.src: 12  I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

p.src: 13  And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

en: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.
